datasets.name: IntPlaceOutBDatSet
datasets.sql:
select  c.CREDITID ,
        c.HDATE ,
        c.STOPCALCDATE ,
        c.REST ,
        c.INTERESTREST ,
        c.DUEREST ,
        c.DUEINTERESTREST ,
        p.name ,
        c.INTERESTREST+c.DUEREST as SumRest,
        a.numberofcredit as num
from cm_curr_state c, 
     cm_sb_customers p,
     cm_active_credits a
where c.creditid in (select creditid from cm_int_outbalance)
      and c.creditid in (select id from cm_active_credits a where a.boorowerid=p.id )
      and c.creditid = a.id

datasets.name: out_payments
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, creditid, trdate, tramount
  FROM cm_return_int_outb 
  where creditid = :CrdID
  order by  trdate
